payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively tries all possible block sizes k, uses 2D prefix sums to compute ones in each k×k block, and toggles min(ones, zeros) pixels to minimize total toggles; no pruning or bounding.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over k and computes exact cost per block via prefix sums, lacking true branch and bound but aligning closest among the given subtypes due to the search over k for a minimum.
